gaps.title: Cold chain compliance across expanding hospital network
gaps.detail: Medanta is rapidly adding new hospitals (550‑bed Noida, 400‑bed Varanasi) and aims for 7,000 beds, increasing the volume of vaccines, biologics, and temperature‑sensitive supplies that must meet India's Revised Schedule M and WHO‑GDP standards.
gaps.based_on: In 2026 Medanta aims for around 3,000 operational beds and plans to reach 7,000 beds over the next 3–4 years… 550‑bed super‑speciality hospital operational in Noida. 400‑bed multi‑speciality hospital announced in Varanasi.

gaps.title: Distributed high‑value medical asset visibility
gaps.detail: With multiple new sites and a workforce of 1,001‑5,000, Medanta will have numerous critical devices (MRI, ventilators, surgical equipment) that need real‑time location and tamper alerts to prevent loss or downtime.
gaps.based_on: The organization employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

gaps.title: Manual inventory processes in multi‑site pharmacies
gaps.detail: Rapid hospital expansion likely relies on legacy inventory methods for drugs and consumables, creating inefficiencies and audit risks under stricter regulatory traceability requirements.
gaps.based_on: Medanta operates in the healthcare industry as a multi‑specialty hospital network.

gaps.title: Need for unified IoT data platform
gaps.detail: As Medanta integrates sensors for temperature, equipment usage, and location across new facilities, a single dashboard would streamline compliance reporting and operational insights.
gaps.based_on: In 2026 Medanta continues its aggressive expansion journey with an estimated operational capacity of around 3,000 beds.

pitch.angle:
- Your new 550‑bed Noida and 400‑bed Varanasi hospitals will double your vaccine storage footprint—our ThinxFresh platform guarantees real‑time temperature compliance across all sites.
- With a target of 7,000 beds, managing high‑value equipment across dozens of locations becomes critical; our asset trackers cut loss risk and provide instant alerts.
- Regulatory pressure from Revised Schedule M and WHO‑GDP audits demands automated cold‑chain logs—our solution auto‑generates audit‑ready reports.
- Consolidate all sensor data from new campuses into a single dashboard for quick decision‑making and reduced manual work.
pitch.opener: Congrats on the ambitious 7,000‑bed rollout—let's ensure your expanding clinical network stays compliant and operationally efficient with real‑time cold‑chain and asset visibility.
